conclusion: every field the producer actually reads has a bounded right context: event-local for participation, timing, delay dispersion and waveform descriptors, and a closed 200-second processing segment for the band and cross-band coordinates. The observed zero-to-sixty-minute publication lag is a one-hour packaging convention, not an intrinsic measurement latency. A complete low-latency rebuild of the whole recording was not produced in this package, and that does not block the D-delayed main line.
